scripts.reason: quarterly_atm_straddle_management_summary.md: laddered entry (spread the quarterly roll over ~5 trading days instead of one lump-sum day, matched capital) beats quarterly_atm_short_straddle.py's baseline on total P&L/Sharpe/drawdown on both 510050 and 510300, in both discovery/holdout windows, AND survives realistic slippage (0.005-0.02 idx pts/leg) since it trades the same total notional, not extra volume -- promising, not yet live in alerts_core.py. Profit target (close at 50% of credit, reload same expiry) looks equally good at zero slippage but requires real extra round-trips (43/46 and 23/26 cycles reload) and its edge collapses to net-negative under the same slippage grid -- same failure mode as quarterly_restrike_short_straddle.py; do not adopt.

quarterly_delta_strangle_short_backtest_summary.md: MIXED — delta-targeted legs vs. quarterly_atm_short_straddle.py's ATM legs, same always-on hold-to-expiry cadence. At matched capital (delta configs levered to the ATM straddle's avg margin), 510050 favors staying at ATM (better Sharpe/drawdown), 510300 favors a delta~0.40 strangle (better P&L/Sharpe) — no consistent cross-underlying edge, and each underlying only offers ~26-46 independent quarterly draws. Not live in alerts_core.py; not rejected either, needs a longer sample or a specific hypothesis for the underlying disagreement before a verdict.

quarterly_restrike_short_straddle_summary.md: REJECTED — periodically re-striking the quarterly ATM short straddle within the same fixed expiry (calendar-monthly or trading-day cadence, with/without a late-cycle DTE floor) underperforms the static quarterly_atm_short_straddle.py hold-to-expiry baseline in both discovery (<2024-01-01) and holdout (>=2024-01-01) windows, at both zero and realistic (0.01 index-pt) slippage — even at zero slippage the naive version already loses to the baseline, confirming the a priori concern that later re-strikes sell thinner premium (falling DTE) into rising ATM gamma

ETF beta with clipped upside, intact downside. Not live
